items.Sentence: The WQCF was originally constructed with an Imhoff tank treatment system in the 1950s

The AIPS consists of three sequentially-connected ponds, identified as primary, secondary, and tertiary... The first cell being the deepest functions as an anaerobic digester to breakdown solids. The primary pond contains three floating brush aerators... The tertiary pond provides polishing and allows algae to be settled.

The NASTS contains an aeration oxidation ditch and two clarifiers for solids separation... the NASTS was de-rated by the Discharger from 1.0 MGD to 0.80 MGD to allow the system to operate as a Simultaneous Nitrification Dentification process to meet an effluent nitrogen limit
In 2022 the City constructed a 200,000-gallon concrete tank to add an anoxic zone to the existing oxidation ditch. This will improve the reliability and consistency of nitrogen removal...
The NASTS contains an aeration oxidation ditch and two clarifiers for solids separation.
The SASTS consists of an oxidation ditch, a secondary clarifier, a return activated sludge/waste activated sludge pump station...
Waste sludge produced by this system is metered and pumped to SASTS Aerobic Digesters 1, 2 and 3 for stabilization and dewatering.
A centrifuge is used to dewater solids from the digesters. Centrate from the centrifuge is returned to the headworks for treatment.

There are 13 unlined sand drying beds located on the NASTS side... Historically, sludge drying beds were used for solids dewatering, but this practice was discontinued in 2010 when the centrifuge was installed. The drying beds are now only used in an emergency...
Influent flows enter a mechanical bar screen before being pumped from the influent pump station to the NASTS distribution structure and the SASTS flow splitter structure.

Undisinfected secondary effluent is discharged for disposal to a series of 15 percolation ponds covering approximately 100 acres.
Bar screenings are disposed off-site at a permitted landfill site.
